transfer.title: Tuition Transfer Guide
transfer.subtitle: How Turkmenistan students officially transfer tuition payments abroad
transfer.calculator_desc: Calculate how much you can transfer under the annual cap
transfer.cap_warning: Exceeds the annual $12,000 cap. Only $12,000 can be transferred officially.
transfer.rate_info: Exchange rate: 1 USD = {rate} TMT (Central Bank of Turkmenistan, fixed)
transfer.step1_desc: Verify that your university has the MoE Approved badge — only approved universities are eligible for official transfers.
transfer.step2_desc: Obtain an official tuition invoice from your university in USD or the local currency.
transfer.step3_desc: Visit a licensed Turkmen bank (Türkmenbank, Halkbank, etc.) with your invoice, passport, and student documents.
transfer.step4_desc: The bank submits the transfer request to the Ministry of Education for approval. This can take several working days.
transfer.step5_desc: Once approved, the bank executes the transfer at the official Central Bank rate (3.51 TMT = 1 USD).
transfer.disclaimer: UniPath is a guide platform only. We do not process or facilitate payments. Always follow official procedures at a licensed bank.
transfer.moe_only_note: Only MoE-approved universities qualify for official transfers. Use the 'Transfer eligible' filter when searching.

support.title: Support & FAQ
support.subtitle: Learn about UniPath and find answers to common questions
support.about_desc: UniPath is a free guide platform helping Turkmenistan students discover universities abroad, compare options, and understand the official tuition transfer process through the Ministry of Education.
support.about_free_desc: UniPath is completely free for all students. No subscriptions or hidden fees.
support.about_guide_only_desc: We provide information and guidance only. We never process payments or submit applications.
support.about_moe_desc: Our platform reflects the official MoE transfer rules and approved university list.
support.faq_what_body: UniPath is an independent guide platform for Turkmenistan students planning to study abroad. You can search and compare universities, track your application documents, and learn about the official tuition transfer process — all in one place. UniPath is free and does not handle money or visa applications.
support.faq_moe_body: The 'MoE Approved' badge means the university is on the official list approved by the Turkmenistan Ministry of Education. Only these universities qualify for the official $12,000/year tuition transfer through a licensed Turkmen bank.
support.faq_cap_body: Turkmenistan allows students to officially transfer up to $12,000 USD per year for tuition at MoE-approved universities. At the fixed Central Bank rate of 3.51 TMT per USD, this equals 42,120 TMT annually. Use our Transfer Calculator to compute exact amounts.
support.faq_payment_body: No. UniPath is a guide platform only and never handles money. To make a tuition transfer, you must visit a licensed Turkmen bank (e.g., Türkmenbank, Halkbank) in person with your tuition invoice and student documents.
support.faq_tracker_title: How does the Application Tracker work?
support.faq_tracker_body: The tracker lets you save dream universities, track documents needed for each application, and monitor your progress. Create a free account and sign in to access it. Your data is private and only visible to you.
support.faq_compare_body: Go to the Universities page, click 'Compare' on up to 3 universities, then visit the Compare page to see them side by side — tuition, ranking, languages, majors, and MoE status.
support.faq_language_title: How do I change the language?
support.faq_language_body: Use the TK / RU / EN buttons in the top navigation bar. UniPath is available in Turkmen, Russian, and English. Your language preference is saved automatically.
support.faq_contact_body: For questions or feedback, email us at ezizagamyradov@gmail.com. We aim to respond within 2 business days.
support.contact_desc: Send us a message — we're happy to help.
